mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.total_rooms AS totalRooms, i.booked_rooms AS bookedRooms, i.checked_in_rooms AS checkedInRooms, i.available_rooms AS availableRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND d.is_deleted = 0) AS detailCount FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND i.stay_date = #{stayDate} AND i.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room_type_inventory SET booked_rooms = #{booked}, checked_in_rooms = #{checkedIn}, available_rooms = #{available} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND total_rooms = #{booked} + #{checkedIn} + #{available}
mapper.select: SELECT i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.total_rooms = i.booked_rooms + i.checked_in_rooms + i.available_rooms FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.id = #{inventoryId}
